questions.q_en: If a boy climbs 16 m on a pole in the first one minute and 4 m comes down in the next one minute, then how long will it be at the peak of the pole? The total length of the pole is 184 m.
questions.solution_en:
Boys covers distance in 2 minutes = 16 - 4 = 12 m

Hence, the required time = 2 * (184 - 16) /12 + 1 minute of last 16 m

= 28 minutes + 1 minute

= 29 minutes
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: A bicycle can cover 234 km in 18 hours. Find the distance covered by train in 55 hours which is moving at speed which is 80% more than speed of bicycle.
questions.solution_en:
Speed of bicycle = 234/18 = 13 km/hr

Speed of train = 180% of 13 = 23.4 km/hr

Required distance = 23.4 * 55 = 1287 km

questions.q_en: Rohan started a journey from point 'A' at 2:35:20 p.m. and reached point 'B' at 11:18:15 a.m. Kripa started from point 'A' 1 hour 24 mins 40 secs after Rohan and reached point 'B' 41 mins 45 secs after him. How long did Kripa take to complete his journey?
questions.solution_en:
Rohan started a journey from point 'A' at 2:35:20 p.m.

Kripa started from point 'A' 24 mins 40 secs after Rohan

2:35:20 + 1:24:40 = 4:00:00

Rohan reaches point 'B' at 11:18:15 a.m.

Kripa reaches point 'B' 41 mins 45 secs after Rohan.

11:18:15 + 00:41:45 = 12:00:00

Kripa starts the journey from 4:00:00 and completes the journey at 12:00:00 of next day.

Total time taken by Kripa = 8 hours + 12 hours = 20 hours

Kripa takes 20 hours to complete his journey.

A person's office is 180 km away from his home. To reach his office he travelled one - sixth of the distance at 15 km/hour, half of the distance at 40 km/hour and the remaining distance at 30 km/hour. Find the total time taken by him.
questions.solution_en:
Total distance = 180 km

Time taken to cover one - sixth of the distance

=> 180/(6 * 15) = 2 hours

Time taken to cover half of the distance

=> 180/(2 * 40) = 2.25 hours

Time taken to cover remaining distance = (180 - 30 - 90)/30 = 2 hours

Total time = 2 + 2.25 + 2 = 6.25 hours

questions.q_en: If a car takes 15 hours to cover 600 km, how long will it take to cover 1500 m at the same speed?
Adarsh travels 3/8 part of the journey at the speed of 27 km/h, 1/6 part of the journey at the speed of 30 km/h and rest of the journey at the speed of 33 km/h. Find the average speed of Adarsh.
questions.solution_en:
Let total distance travelled by Adarsh = 24a (LCM of 8 and 6)

Remaining journey = 1 - 3/8 - 1/6 = 11/24

Total time taken = (24a*3/8)/27 + (24a*1/6)/30 + (24a*11/24)/33

= a/3 + 2a/15 + a/3

= 4a/5

Average speed = 24a/(4a/5) = 30 km/h

questions.q_en: Bhuvan travels at the speed of 35 km/h by car in 2.4 hours and 12 km/h on foot in 36 minutes. Find his average speed.
questions.solution_en:
Distance travelled by Bhuvan by car = 35*2.4 = 84 km

Distance travelled by Bhuvan on foot = 12*36/60 = 7.2 km

Average speed = (84 + 7.2)/(2.4 + 0.6) = 91.2/3 = 30.4 km/h
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Two cars 1350 m apart are travelling in same direction and the faster car overtakes the slower car from behind in 270 seconds. 1350 m apart if they travel towards each other, they will meet after 30 seconds. Find the speed of both the cars (in km/hr).
questions.solution_en:
Let, the speed of faster car is 'a' m/s and the slower car is 'b' m/s.

Time = distance/ speed

According to question,

270 = 1350/ (a - b) [when moving in the same direction, subtract speed]

(a - b) = 5 ....... eq (i)

30 = 1350/ (a + b) [when moving in opposite direction, add speed]

(a + b) = 45 ...... eq (ii)

From eq (i) and eq (ii), we get -

a = 25 m/s = 25 * 18/5 = 90 km/hr

b = 20 m/s = 20 * 18/5 = 72 km/hr

[To convert m/s into km/hr multiply by 18/5]

questions.q_en: X and Y are two stations which are 280 km apart. A train starts at a certain time from X and travels towards Y at 60 km/h. After 2 hours, another train starts from Y and travels towards X at 20 km/h. After how much time from the start of train which left from X, both trains meet?
questions.solution_en:
Distance covered by the train leaving from X in 2 hr = 60 * 2 = 120 km

Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km

Now, relative speed = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr

Time in which both trains meet after the train leaving from Y started = 160/80 = 2 hr

Required time = 2 + 2 = 4 hr
questions.solution_hi:

Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km

Now, relative speed = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr

Time in which both trains meet after the train leaving from Y started = 160/80 = 2 hr

Required time = 2 + 2 = 4 hr

questions.q_en: A bike covers a certain distance at a certain time at the speed of 64 km/hr. If at the speed of 72 km/hr, the bike covers 40 km more at the same time, then find the original distance (in km) covered by the bike.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time be 't' hour.

According to question,

72 * t - 64 * t = 40 km

t = 5

The original distance = 5 * 64 = 320 km

questions.q_en: A policeman noticed a thief from 400 m. The thief started running and the policeman was chasing him. The thief and the policeman ran at the speeds of 14 km/hr and 15 km/hr, respectively. What was the distance between them after 4 minutes?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 15 - 14 = 1 km/hr

Distance between policeman and thief after 4 minutes = 1 x (4/60) km = 1/15 km

Initial distance = 400 m = 2/5 km

Required distance = (2/5) - (1/15) = 5/15 = 1/3 km
questions.solution_hi:

Distance between policeman and thief after 4 minutes = 1 x (4/60) km = 1/15 km

questions.q_en: Train A takes 35 minutes more than train B to travel a distance of 460 km. Due to engine trouble speed of train B falls by a quarter, so it takes 30 minutes more than train A to complete the same journey. What is the speed of train A (in km/hr)?
questions.solution_en:
Speed ratio of train B = 4: 3

So, the time ratio of train B = 3: 4

Time difference between train A and B = 35 + 30 = 65 minutes

Time taken by train A = 65 * 3 + 35 = 230 min = 23/6 hours

Speed of train A = 460 * 6/23 = 120 km/hr
questions.solution_hi:

questions.q_en: Speed of two cars M and N are 15 m/s and 40/3 m/s respectively. If car M covers a certain distance in 9 hours, then in how much time car N can cover the same distance? (correct up to two decimals)
questions.solution_en:
For same distance,

Speed of M/Speed of N = Time taken by N/Time taken by M

Time taken by N = [15/(40/3)] * 9 = 10.125 = 10.13 hours

questions.q_en: Two persons M and N started moving towards each other from their respective homes at the same time. The speed of M is (6/5)th of the speed of N. After meeting N on the way M took 2 hours 30 minutes to reach N's home, then how much time was taken by N to reach M's home after meeting M on the way?
questions.solution_en:
Consider the following

t1 = time taken by M to reach N's home after meeting N on the way

t2= time taken by N to reach M's home after meeting M on the way

v1 = speed of M

v2 = speed of N

Here,

t1 = 2 hours 30 minutes = 2.5 hours

v1 = 6v2/5

or, v2/v1 = 5/6

Now,

t1/t2 = (v2/v1)2

or, 2.5/t2 = (5/6)2 = 25/36

or, t2 = 2.5*36/25 = 3.6 hours

questions.q_en: A policeman starts to chase a thief. When thief moves 12 steps, the policeman moves 8 steps. Also 4 steps of policeman is equal to 7 steps of thief. If the speed of thief is 30 km/hr, then find the speed of policeman?
questions.solution_en:
Let the step of police be P and step of thief be T.

Given, 4P = 7T

P = 7T/4

8P = 8*7T/4 = 14T

It is given that when the policeman moves 8 steps, the thief moves 12 steps

Therefore ratio of speed = 14:12 = 7:6

6x = 30, x = 5 km/hr

Therefore 7x = 35 km/hr

questions.q_en: Abbasi rides motorcycle at a speed of 30 km/h and after 1 hr, Rashid starts from the same place at 40 km/h. After how much time from when Abbasi starts that Rashid will catch him?
questions.solution_en:
Both travel same distance, Abbasi travels in 't' hrs time while Rashid in (t - 1) hrs.

30(t) = 40(t-1)

=> 30t = 40t - 40

=> 10t = 40

=> t = 4 hrs

questions.q_en: A boy covers a certain distance. If he covers half of the distance at the speed of 25 km/h and after that increases his speed by 20%, then find the average speed of the boy.
questions.solution_en:
Let the total distance be 'd' km

1st half speed = 25 km/ h

Second half speed = 25 X 120/100 = 30 km/h

Average speed = 2 X S1 X S2 / S1 + S1

= 2 X 25 X 30 / 25 + 30 km/h

= 300/11 km/h

Hence, the average speed of the boy = 300/11 km/h
